newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom keeping to Yahaya's strategy.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom keeping to Yahaya's strategy.

text.p: Malaysia's DRB-Hicom group said on Thursday that it would keep to the same strategy and vision set down by its late chairman Yahaya Ahmad.
"The vision, mission and strategies laid by the late Tan Sri Yahaya will be continued," said newly-named successor Saleh Sulong in a speech to reporters at a news conference.
He also said that the major projects and programs of the company "will be pursued with the same vigour, drive and pace" as during the time of Yahaya, who died on Monday in a helicopter crash.

Saleh, who was deputy chairman of the companies which are parent over national carmaker Proton Bhd and a stable of other transportation-linked firms, was Yahaya's close associate and was expected to continue his legacy.
They had worked together for almost 20 years.
He said the systems and processes within the companies "are well prepared and capable of meeting any future challenges".
Yahaya had been chairman of Proton since 1995, when he was handpicked by Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad to revamp the company to equip it for the onslaught of international competition.
